annotation.bound_parties_text: The act binds motor vehicle manufacturers running SAVE projects, owners of ADS-operated vehicles, persons operating motor vehicles without a human driver, political subdivisions (barred from prohibiting or regulating ADS vehicles), and parents/guardians or accompanying persons for child restraint duties.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: each motor vehicle manufacturer is responsible for the safe operation of its participating fleet.
annotation.dates_quote: SECTION 20. This act shall take effect upon becoming a law, the public welfare requiring it.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 5; Title 6; Title 7; Title 39; Title 40; Title 54; Title 55; Title 56; Title 65 and Title 67, relative to autonomous vehicles.
